issue.title: test_enter_returns_while_xprompt_file_read_is_blocked fails under the full parallel lane, passes in isolation
issue.description:
DISCOVERED BY: bead sase-n7.3 during epic sase-n7 ('Get monitor reconciliation off the ACE startup critical path'), recorded as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP and routed to a task by sase-n7.land on 2026-08-16.

OBSERVATION: tests/ace/tui/test_xprompt_browser_load_keymap.py::test_enter_returns_while_xprompt_file_read_is_blocked failed during phase sase-n7.3's first 'just check', where the scoped lane escalated to the whole suite. The node passed when rerun in isolation, and the phase's second full 'just check' was green. The phase's own diff touched only src/sase/monitor/store.py (a bounded artifact-index query for monitor reconciliation) and tests/monitor/, so the failure is unrelated to the change under test. The same escalated run also failed tests/test_config.py::test_load_merged_config_invalid_yaml_skipped, which was routed separately as a +1 on sase-mv.

CLASS: green in isolation, red only when the whole suite runs in parallel -- the shape sase-ct was retired for. The node exercises the xprompt browser's Enter handler while an xprompt file read is deliberately blocked, so it is timing- and receiver-sensitive by construction, which is the usual signature of process-global state or scheduler contention leaking in from elsewhere in the suite rather than intra-file contention.

SCOPE: reproduce under the full parallel lane (narrow file-scoped 'just test-contention' is NOT sufficient evidence for this class -- see sase-mv, where file-level contention was already green while the full lane was red), identify whether the trigger is a poisoning test or a genuine race in the blocked-read path, fix the leak or make the node robust, then re-measure with the full parallel lane plus 'just selection-health' and tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt.

IMPACT: an unpredictable red node in 'just check' escalations and 'just check-full', so agents landing unrelated work must hand-triage before landing. Single observation so far; corroborate rather than duplicate if it recurs.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired umbrella for 'flaky ACE TUI tests under the full parallel just test run'. Its close reason forbids +1/reopen and routes exactly this shape of report to a narrow task named for the failing node ID, which is why this bead exists instead of a corroboration.

RELATED: sase-j7 — in-progress epic 'Fix the sase-ct flake class at its root - process-global state leaking between tests'. If this node's trigger turns out to be a poisoning test rather than a race in the blocked-read path, sase-j7.2's global-state leak detector is the natural instrument, and sase-j7's land agent should know a node in this class was still red on master on 2026-08-16.

RELATED: sase-mv — the other node routed out of the same sase-n7 phase runs (tests/test_config.py config-cache class). Same 'red only in the full parallel lane' class but a different subsystem and a different likely root cause, so it was corroborated there rather than folded into this bead.

evidence.note: Reproduced in CI (not the full parallel local lane) during epic sase-um.9.5, proposed by phase bead sase-um.9.5.4 (note #8) on 2026-08-29. Master Gate run 33244341435, shard test(7) job 99079106997 on SHA ca7692ee3: tests/ace/tui/test_xprompt_browser_load_keymap.py::test_enter_returns_while_xprompt_file_read_is_blocked raised an unhandled textual.css.query.NoMatches for '#frontmatter-raw' on the hidden FrontmatterPanel — the same node and the same selector this bead already records. New root-cause evidence for whoever works it: the NoMatches is raised from FrontmatterPanel/PromptInputBar on_mount, when load_xprompt_definition_into_home_prompt_bar mounts the bar after pop_screen while Path.read_text is still blocked, so it is a production mount race rather than only a parallel-lane scheduling artifact. Negative result worth keeping: deferring that on_mount setup through call_after_refresh makes the query empty during on_mount on the common path and fails 468 PromptInputBar tests, so the fix needs a mount-safe bind, not a deferral. The epic worked around the CI failure with a test-only wait (commit 4a8b8358f) and explicitly did not patch the production race.
